packageRules.description: bosa/opendata-best-webapi is the BeSt Address register: the image IS the dataset, tagged YYYY-WW for the ISO week of the address extract (2026-35, 2026-36, ...). Renovate's default docker versioning reads 2026-35 as major 2026 with compatibility suffix 35, and would then only ever look for another -35 tag, so the weekly address-data refresh would silently never be offered. The character class is [0-9] rather than a backslash-d escape so the rule needs no JSON escaping and cannot be broken by a stray backslash.
